description: Kept its word: whether each place an actuary might sweep cash into did what it said, month by month, from SEC filings. Money-market funds (N-MFP3: SEC Rule 2a-7 liquidity and $1 price held every business day, 7-day yield), short-term Treasury and bond funds (N-PORT: months without a loss, worst month, compounded return), and monthly dividend payers (10-K: years the dividend held, yield, boat signs). Give a ticker for one record, or none for all. Facts from filings, not advice.

ticker.description: e.g. VMFXX, SGOV, O. Leave empty for every place.

name: get_sweep_record
